umi4_op-L0001.text: "Wahahahaha, you alright, Battler‐kun...?! We're already on the ground, y'know, you can't fall any further than that, wahahahaha...!"

Battler's uproar in the plane must have been very funny to her.

umi4_op-L0015.text: "Battler‐kun, why don't you come with your aunt on an overseas trip sometime soon? What about Europe? I'm sure you'd conquer your fears after the half‐day plane trip. *giggle*giggle*giggle*!"

umi4_op-L0022.text: "......For some reason, she just couldn't handle vehicles. Pretty much anything other than a bicycle or a car. Whenever we tried to take a trip somewhere far away, that woman was so annoying with the "no not this, no not that, I'm scared I'm scared, I'm going to fall I'm going to fall, scream scream"."

People who were in the middle of walking—frozen, with one foot still raised.
Scraps of paper dancing in the wind—frozen, pinned in midair.

...That was all. In a normal world, that probably wouldn't even count as movement, but in this still world, it looked very out of place.

Of course, the woman was also a witch.

umi4_op-L0097.text: "What verbal acrobatics a six‐year‐old girl could possibly perform to persuade them to turn back, I can't even imagine. ......But yes. If you had been in this place, the probability wouldn't have been zero. If there is a probability other than zero, I can find a miracle."

...What happened on that day?
I will expose that. Learn that. And I'll take them back...!

umi4_op-L0140.text:
As she stood there with her fists still clenched, she surely turned her face to the heavens.
A single teardrop from the depths of her eyes dripped down into the air. And when time started moving again, the two witches' figures were sucked into a blowing gale, and erased in an instant.
